findings.current: Chasing the surviving allies and, at the same time, chasing the surviving allies to break through the second line of defense in their path.
findings.defect: The same pursuit is stated twice, obscuring the second action.
findings.rationale: Preserves both the pursuit and the advance without repeating the same clause.
findings.replacement: They were hunting down the survivors while advancing on the second line of defense.
findings.source: Chapter 1020, Taekyung’s assessment after the Dunhuang report

findings.current: By now, everyone had heard the news that the front line at Dunhuang, built around the Kongtong Sect, had been utterly crushed half a day ago.
findings.defect: Places Dunhuang’s defeat half a day earlier, although the Chapter 1020 messenger said it happened about three days before his report.
findings.rationale: Removes the conflicting timestamp without assigning an unsupported exact time to the travelers’ arrival.
findings.replacement: By now, everyone had heard the news that the front line at Dunhuang, built around the Kongtong Sect, had been utterly crushed.
findings.source: Chapter 1022, approach to the Great Snow Mountain

findings.current: Their comrades, the people they shared meals with, came back as corpses overnight.
findings.defect: “Overnight” conflicts with this chapter’s account that the scouts left four hours earlier and encountered the enemy two hours earlier.
findings.rationale: Keeps the speaker’s point about the defenders’ shock without introducing a conflicting interval.
findings.replacement: Their comrades, the people they shared meals with, went out scouting and came back as corpses.
findings.source: Chapter 1024, enemy group discussing the scouts

findings.current: not even when they trampled Dunhuang, defended by the Zhongnan Sect, in an instant.
findings.defect: Names the Zhongnan Sect as Dunhuang’s defenders; the reading copies, summary, and active state identify the Kongtong Sect.
findings.rationale: Corrects the faction attribution at a major battle without changing the sentence’s other claims.
findings.replacement: not even when they trampled Dunhuang, defended by the Kongtong Sect, in an instant.
findings.source: Chapter 1024, Blood-Sword Demon Lord assessing his army

summary: The reading copies and active state largely agree. Four actionable issues remain: a duplicated action, two timing conflicts, and a sect misidentification.
